description: Records are not protected from loss, destruction, falsification, and unauthorized access.
applicability: Applies when an organization does not adequately protect important records from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access, and unauthorized release in accordance with legal, regulatory, contractual, and business requirements.

metadata.detection_notes: Review records management policies and procedures, verify records classification and retention schedules, check access controls for records systems, assess backup and recovery for records, examine disposal procedures for records, verify compliance with retention requirements.
